sanskrit: rahasyāṇāṃ (nāṃ) rahasyaṃ hi yantraṃ pañcākṣarasya tunityaṃ hi loka rakṣārthaṃ yantraṃ rakṣākaraṃ mamaśrīsabhākhyaṃ mahāyantraṃ mama rūpapradarśakamahaṃ pañcākṣaraṃ sākṣāt tvaṃ tu pañcadaśākṣarīāvayoścakrasamelaṃ viṣṇvādīnāma gocarammānañca cakrayogañca pṛthaktvaṃ ca viśeṣataḥsthānaṃ cidambaraṃ prāpya prāsādaṃ mantra vihamdhyāyaṃ cidambaraprasannātma darpaṇe pratibimbavatgandhādibhiralaṃ kṛtya svadehaṃ mantra vigrahamānandamamalaṃ nityaṃ nṛtyantaṃ māṃ maheśvarītvāṃ devi manasābhyarcya soḍaśai rūpa cārakaiḥmāyātmika mahābhakti prāsādā vṛttike priyemahāhṛdayamadhyasthāṃ nṛttamūrtiṃ parāṃ śivāmcatvārīśāṃśakaṃ kṛtvā saṣṭa tanmadhyamaṃ priyesvantantramādyamaparaṃ yāmalaṃ tu śivātmakamdevī mālaṃ karṇikā svā daśadhāsaṃvibhajyatāmpātayannava sūtrāṇi navānāṃ pārśvayoḥ mṛjetmadhyamaṃ ca tathātoyaṃ guṇabhāgaṃ yathā mṛjetṣaṣṭhī dvitīyagā cāsyād aṣṭamī prathamā gataprathamā saptamaspṛṣṭvā caturthā caṣṭamāṃgatāityevaṃ karma sūtrāṇī yojayet sūtrapārśvayoḥvṛttaṃ spṛṣṭvā ṣaḍaśrantu tadaspṛṣṭvāṣṭakaṃ priyesūtrāṇi pātayeddevi ṣoḍaśāśraṃ yathā kramamaṣṭāśrañca triyaśrañca siddhitve ca na saṃśayaḥviracya tava cakrantu mama cakraṃ tato pari
source_edition: Muktabodha M00525 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: caturaśrasamaṃkṛtvā dvātriṃśatirīśakamsūtrāṇi paritaḥ prājñaḥ tadantaścaturaśrakamkalāṃśamūrdhvatā kṛtvā tiryak saptadaśāṃśakamsūtrāt paścimārabhya navamaṃ madhyamaṃ bhavetmadhyato dikpade ṣaṭke sārdhe tanmaṇḍalaṃ bhramettadbahistricatuḥ pañca cāṅgulairmaṇḍaladvayammaṇḍalatraya madhye tu maṇḍalantu paribhrametnavakhaṇḍā yathā bhūmirna ca khaṇḍātmakaṃ tathākoṇastha caturaśrāṇi vyūhārthaṃ parikalpayetśikārañca nakārañca yanmayā parikīrtitamma vāśineya ityāhu rāgneyaṃ pañca pañcakamyañcamañca śivānañca na ca vāmaśikaṃ tathāvakārañca nakārañca maśivanteṣvanu kramātathavakṣye ca vāyavyāṃ manugrahamidaṃ guroḥnama śivāya paścāttu vakāra śimayaṃ na caavagrahamidaṃ proktaṃ vāyavyāṃ pañcapañcakaṃnama śivāya paścāttu makārañca yakārakamvāśidvau ca patyo nyasya vākāraṃ maśiyanna catāḍayedupa sūtrāṇi tiryagūrdhvañca madhyataḥsaptamasya tribhāge tu navame daśamarddhakepañcamasya caturthāṃśe saptame cāṣṭamarddhaketribhāgaika padasyaiva caturdaśa padasya cadakṣabhūta caturthāṃśe cotthitārghyagraka sthitaḥmaṇibandhābhyantaraṃ caiva pāṇe ḍamarukasya himaṇibandhaṃ lambapāṇe pratī caiva varānane
source_edition: Muktabodha M00525 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: abhayasya karasyaiva maṇibandha talāvadhisthitāṅgulāgrakaṃ vāme'bhayāṅguṣṭhāvadhi priyenavamasvartthake sūtre sthita pārṣṇyāvadhi sthitamdaśamārabdha sūtre tu taddhastastala maddhyamamaṣṭamasyārdha bhāge tu sphik piṇḍāvapuryathātrayodaśārdha sūtre tu cakṣuṣormadhyamaṃ priyeevaṃ sūtrodbhavaṃ kṛtvā viśeṣāntaṃ ca sūtrataḥtrisaptakṛtvo deveśi raśmayaśva pradarśayetvarṇān vā puṣpikāṃ vāpi savarṇāpuṣpikā'thavāetaccakraṃ mahāgauri mamarūpa pradarśakamśilpinā śāstramārgeṇa kāryaṃ pra aṃgapūraṇamsarvadevātmakaṃ padmaṃ prabhāvalayammūligamsarvādi pañcakopetaṃ mantra śruti samanvitametat padmaṃ mahādevi mantrābjaparikalpitamdvāviṃśatiśca rekhāḥ ca madhye praṇava vāmayoḥṣaḍakṣaraṃ tu vinyasya prāsantu ṣaḍakṣaramnama śivāya ityevaṃ praṇavāntāṃ punaḥ priyeparipañcākṣaraṃ nyasya madhye praṇavamālayoḥakārādi kṣakārāntaṃ praṇavādi namontakamvinyasedguptamantrasya prāṇamantraṃ navākṣaramaṃguṣṭhe tu yakāraḥ syāt vākāraṃ tarjanī nyasetkaniṣṭhe tu na rautaṃ syāt sṛṣṭimārgeṇa ceśvarīgulphapāṇyośca jaṃghe ca jānvorū guhya deśakebāhū kūrparadeśe tu maṇibandhe maheśvarimakāraṃ ca yakārañca śikāraṃ sūkṣmapañcakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00525 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ḍamaruṃ valayaścaiva tantu yattu kaṭikramātnayo namavoyeti vāme corddhve karāgrakekaṇṭhe karṇāsthi gāsye tu nāsāgre ca yathā kramamādyaṃ śivaṃ bhruvormadhye madhye haṃsa sudīptakamdvādaśārṇaṃ jaṭājūṭe gaṃgā māyā vāmakejāntaṃ nṛtyañca saṃyuktaṃ candrakhaṇḍaṃ ca dakṣiṇeśiro lalāṭe bhrūmadhye gaṇḍoṣṭha gala dṛksu caanuloma vilomena haṃsaṃ hṛdaya pārśvakenyasennavātmakaṃ devi karṇe vakṣasi baindavemālāśca vinyaseddevī karṇe sākṣānmahāmanumprādakṣiṇya krameṇaiva prabhāmūle tu vinyasetvinyaseddevi mūle tu śivāyeti pradakṣiṇamdakṣiṇāṃ vithimārabhya prādakṣiṇya kramāllikhethrīṃ śrīṃ aiṃ haṃ saścetyuttareṣu padeṣu canama śivāya mantreṇa lavaraya hā kṣaram likhetśrīṃ hrīṃ aiṃ klīṃ haṃ saśceti likhet kramātcakre ca mārjayeddevī mamāṅgasya bahiḥ sthitāḥvāmabhāge svatantrasyāṃ nṛttālokanalīlayāathavā yāmale vāme prabhāvalaya madhyagāmālayoścakra saṃmelaṃ mantrayogañca tatvataḥteṣāṃ hi bhakti mā nityaṃ muktidā darśana priyemantrārṇavā mahādevi mantrakṣīrārṇavoddhṛtamidaṃ rahasyaṃ pāpaghnaṃ bhuktidaṃ muktidaṃ priyegopanīyaṃ prayatnena na deyaṃ yasya kasya cit
